messages.subject: [R-sig-Geo] Online course - LiDAR Data Analysis in R
messages.subject_clean: Online course - LiDAR Data Analysis in R
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

There are only 2 seats for the 3-day online course on LiDAR Data Analysis in R (4th edition).
 
Course website: [ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ) 
 
This course is designed to help participants move from foundational concepts to practical data analysis workflows.
 
Over three days, participants will:

Learn the core principles of LiDAR data acquisition and ecological applications

Work hands-on with point clouds using the lidR package in R

Generate key products such as DTM, DSM, and CHM

Extract ecological and forestry metrics from LiDAR data

Explore individual tree detection and forest structure analysis

Use QGIS to access and work with spaceborne LiDAR data (GEDI)
The course is highly practical and designed for researchers who want to confidently process, analyse, and interpret LiDAR data for ecological and forestry applications.
 
We would be grateful if you could share this announcement with colleagues or students who may be interested.
 
Best regards,
Carlo
--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D
